```{r setup}
project_root <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
setwd(project_root)

# To add a new package: renv::install("packageName") or renv::install("bioc::packageName"), then renv::snapshot(). Snapshots are always run in the console

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, DESeq2, tximport)
```

```{r muscle-genes}
# Myf5, Myog and Myf6 are missing from the Del-Tsonis transcriptome, so the myotube time course was also aligned (salmon) to 
# the Sandberg transcriptome (Abdullayev et al., 2013). Transcript-level vst values of their contigs go into the Fig. 2F heatmap (muscle_diff.csv, read by A1_diff_dediff.Rmd)
dir <- "sandberg_reference_realigned_bulk/salmon_MT_quant_Sandberg_reference"

coldata <- read.table(file.path(dir, "samples.txt"), header = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint))
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$replicate

files <- setNames(file.path(dir, coldata$filename), coldata$replicate)
txi <- tximport(files, type = "salmon", txOut = TRUE)

# Pre-filter -> at least 10 counts in 3 samples, as for the Del-Tsonis data
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData = coldata, design = ~ timepoint)
dds <- DESeq(dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3, ])

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

muscle <- assay(vsd)[c("comp460329_c0_seq1", "comp799573_c0_seq1", "comp117581_c0_seq1"), ]
rownames(muscle) <- c("Myf5", "Myog", "Myf6")

write.csv(muscle, "muscle_diff.csv")
```
